create_MultiModalBudget: create a MultiModalBudget instance to calculate encoder and decoder budget limits for multi-modal models
test_get_mm_max_toks_per_item: test the get_mm_max_toks_per_item function to compute maximum tokens per item for each modality
build_encoder_budget: build encoder compute and cache budget values from scheduler config and active modality token counts
get_modality_max_tokens: get the modality name with the maximum tokens per item from a MultiModalBudget instance
reset_mm_cache: reset the multi-modal encoder cache to clear cached embeddings from a MultiModalBudget instance
